messages:
mia: Heads-up — Hightower LoRA merge (customer Hightower) on int4 shows repeated stop tokens and a token-probability skew in generation. Seeing customer reports and internal smoke failing. Can someone triage?

sam: Can you drop a minimal failing example and the eval command you ran?

mia: example below (trimmed):
```
PROMPT: "Summarize the incident briefly."
OUTPUT: "The incident ended. <STOP> <STOP> <STOP>"
TOKENS+PROBS: "The(0.12) incident(0.09) ended(0.04) .(0.03) <STOP>(0.62) <STOP>(0.80) <STOP>(0.88)"
```
This looks like stop-token prob jumps after quant/adapter applied. Eval command: `./run_quickpack --model hightower-lora-merge-int4 --prompts cust_hightower_smokepack.json --metrics token_prob_shift,accuracy --out /tmp/hight_qp.json`

jakob: Did we change tokenizer or apply any remapping during the LoRA merge step?

mia: No tokenizer changes. Merge was adapter-only. Quant config used: int4 asymmetric, groupsize=128, qkv_fold=true.

anya: I'll spin quickpack now against the customer's prompt set.

deploy-bot: quickpack job 305000-A started by anya (no ETA provided) :gear:

sam: Historically we've seen stop-token probability spikes with asymmetric int4 + kv-cache rounding. Could be rounding propagation in rotary/scaling.

csm-lina: Customer facing. Need ETA to share.

mia: Triage ETA ~ 3 hours for initial root-cause + patch candidate. Assigning: sam -> kernel/quant debug, anya -> full quickpack run + logs, jakob -> verify merge script & token maps. csm-lina -> customer comms.

sam: I'll bisect quant kernels between master and v2-kernel to reproduce.

anya: quickpack finished: 23/200 prompts regressed. Avg stop-token prob delta +0.14, top regressed prompt IDs: [17, 42, 101]. Logs uploaded: /runs/3050001234/hight_qp.json

mia: Thanks. Can you re-run with `--no-kv-fold` and `--token-remap 1.0` to narrow it down?

anya: Re-run queued: `./run_quickpack --model hightower-lora-merge-int4 --prompts cust_hightower_smokepack.json --flags "--no-kv-fold --token-remap=1.0"`

sam: Bisect found the delta: a rounding change in rotary scaling introduced when applying adapter offsets for certain layer norms. Patch candidate: PR #4821 — modifies rotary scale casting and adds tiny epsilon before softmax.

jakob: I'll validate that the merge helper doesn't accidentally cast adapter deltas to int8 during the write step. Quick check PASS on merge script with test vectors.

anya: Re-run results: with `--no-kv-fold` regressions drop to 2/200 and avg delta down to +0.02. With the patch from sam applied locally, full run shows 0 regressions on smoke set.

csm-lina: I'll draft update to Hightower: mention limited regression, we have hotfix + canary rollout planned, ETA for customer-facing patch ~5 hours.

sam: I'll open PR for the patch and add unit tests that cover stop-token probability stability. Will also add a short note in release notes.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: hightower-hotfix-v1 -> 3 nodes (us-west) :rocket:

mia: Great. After canary, let's run a larger eval (2k prompts) before wide release. Assigning follow-up: anya to run full eval post-canary, sam to monitor metrics, jakob to update merge tooling if needed.

csm-lina: I will notify customer and offer temporary rollback if they prefer. :thumbsup:

sam: Patch PR opened -> #4821. CI green on unit tests. Will request reviews.

mia: Thanks everyone — leaving thread open for post-canary results. Will update when full eval finishes. /cc @docs for changelog entry
